title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Mandatory Withdrawal - Fake Documents
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A client provides their paralegal with a rent receipt to be submitted as evidence in a Landlord and Tenant Board (LTB) hearing. The client admits to the paralegal that the receipt was forged in order to strengthen their case. What is the paralegal's **first action** and obligation?
options: Submit the document but refuse to make any oral arguments regarding its validity.
Inform the client that the document cannot be used, and if the client insists on using it, the paralegal must withdraw from representation.
Withdraw from the representation immediately without giving the client an opportunity to change their mind.
Disclose the forged document to the opposing party and the adjudicator immediately.
questions.explain: Under the LSO Paralegal Rules of Conduct, a paralegal must not knowingly assist in or encourage dishonesty, fraud, or illegal conduct. If a client insists on using forged evidence, this triggers a mandatory withdrawal (Rule 8.02). The first action is to advise the client against the illegal act and inform them that the document cannot be used. Only if the client insists must the paralegal withdraw.
